text:
alex: quick heads-up — found a public gist that contains a staging service account key via trufflehog scan. link pasted privately to #sec. probable blast radius: staging + CI runners

maria: thanks alex. creating an incident and kicking off containment now. sam_k you ok to take infra lead? :eyes:

sam_k: on it. first steps: revoke the exposed key, rotate any dependent secrets, and lock RBAC for staging projects. will post commands I run.

security-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1743 by maria. severity: high (credentials public). assigned: sam_k, devops-oncall. audit: auto-collect enabled.

sam_k: immediate checklist (doing now):
1) revoke SA key
2) disable CI runners that use that identity
3) rotate Vault app-role credentials tied to CI
4) enforce temporary RBAC restriction on staging (remove broad roles)

sam_k: revoking key (example command):
```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-staging@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
(replaced with actual key id when running)

devops-oncall: I'm starting a short patch: set all staging service accounts to only allow workload identity and create ephemeral tokens for CI. Pushing a deny policy for role "roles/iam.serviceAccountUser" broad bindings.

maria: eng-sre — can you pull audit logs for the last 48h for that SA and for Vault audit logs? We need any use from unknown IPs and token misuse signs. Also KMS key usage for encrypt/decrypt calls.

eng-sre: pulling logs now. will filter: "serviceAccount:svc-staging@*", Vault audit entries for token create/renew/revoke, Cloud KMS Encrypt/Decrypt. ETA 20m.

alex: also searching GH commits/gists + slack attachments for other exposures. found one more ephemeral token in a private gist forked by an external user — marking for rotation.

maria: good catch. we should rotate any downstream secrets: DB creds, third-party API keys, and any long-lived Vault tokens. plan: rotation script (sam_k) + rolling deploy for staging to pick up new creds. post rotation, we will re-enable CI gradually with ephemeral creds.

sam_k: rotation snippet I'm running (Vault + KMS):
```bash
# rotate Vault AppRole secret_id
vault write auth/approle/role/ci/secret-id -format=json
# rotate wrapped KMS envelope keys (example placeholder)
# ensure new secrets are written to Vault and app config updated
```
I'll run in a maintenance window 15m from now. will tag @devops-oncall for deploy.

devops-oncall: deploying staged workers on new creds now. will keep old tasks scaled down and watch latency/errors.

maria: RBAC lockdown note: any principal with org-level editor was removed from staging project. We'll re-evaluate minimal roles after containment. document all changes in the incident ticket.

eng-sre: audit query results: 3 unexpected decrypt ops from an IP outside our usual ranges around 02:13 UTC, and Vault audit shows a single token creation at 02:12 UTC from CI runner id-runner-7. tagging for review.

sam_k: that matches the time the leaked key was publicly accessible. I've revoked affected tokens and rotated relevant KMS wrapping keys. I've also created temporary deny policy on IAM bindings for staging.

alex: thanks. will scrub any public traces we can find and DM repos to takedown gists. reached out to GH support for takedown on the external gist.

maria: outstanding action owners: sam_k (rotation + RBAC changes), eng-sre (logs + post-incident query), devops-oncall (deploy + CI reconfigure), alex (exposure takedown + repo scan). ETA: initial containment 30m. we'll regroup at +1h for status.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-1743 updated: containment complete (initial). next: forensics and postmortem.

sam_k: quick follow-up — recommend adding automatic scanning in PR checks for leaked service account keys, and enforce short TTL for staging service account tokens. I'll open a PR after postmortem.

maria: agreed. also adding required Vault audit retention extension for 90 days on staging for a bit to help investigations.

alex: thumbs-up. cc @eng-sre if you need any extra logs from our app traces.

eng-sre: saved all relevant logs to secure bucket and attached to the incident. starting deeper forensics now. will update in 45m.

maria: thanks team. please keep updates here. postmortem owners: maria (sec), sam_k (infra). we'll draft corrective actions and timeline by EOD. :white_check_mark:
